examples.code:
Original reusable page contract:
Slots: title, description, primary action, evidence list, FAQ, contact details.
Constraints: title <= 80 characters; one primary action per section; images require alt decisions; no fixed-height copy containers.
States: loading, empty, error, success.
Acceptance: 320px width, 200% zoom, keyboard-only navigation, no motion.
